## Confirmed (3)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |

| `cohort.side` | `R` (choices: R, L) | Lo 2018 Methods, Study Design: right knee only (GEE adjusts for one clustering level) |  |
| `model.corstr` | `exchangeable` (choices: exchangeable, independence) | Lo 2018 Methods, Statistical analysis: GEE with an exchangeable correlation structure |  |

## Assumed (9)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.arthroplasty_scope` | `right` (choices: right, either) | Lo 2018 Results: 35 excluded with arthroplasty at enrollment; right knee gives 38, either knee 63 |  |
| `cohort.reading_project` | `15` | Lo 2018 Methods: central readers; Project 15 reproduces the 877 baseline right-knee SOA exclusion exactly |  |

| `model.trend` | `cochran_armitage` (choices: cochran_armitage, ordinal_term) | Lo 2018 Methods: Cochran-Armitage tests for trend; the adjusted p for trend's method is not stated | Trend p-values are reported, not graded |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_timing` | `by_visit_days` (choices: by_visit_days) | A replacement counts from the first outcome visit whose V##VISDYS is on or after the replacement day |  |
| `outcomes.missing_visit_days` | `nominal_month` (choices: nominal_month) | When a participant has no V##VISDYS for an outcome visit, the replacement-timing check uses the visit's nominal month (config/oai.toml [visits]) in days |  |
| `outcomes.pain_baseline_item` | `P01KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods quote the 12-month frequent-pain question; screening-visit item, as in analyses/lo2022_walking |  |
| `outcomes.pain_followup_item` | `V{visit}KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods: symptoms at 12, 24, 36, 48 months; AllClinical follow-up item |  |

## Open (6)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.missing_baseline_pain` | `not_sx` (choices: not_sx, exclude) | Lo 2018 Results list no exclusion for a blank baseline frequent-pain answer (26 people) | not_sx keeps them, counted as without frequent symptoms at baseline |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope` | `right` (choices: right, either) | Lo 2018 Methods: 'Any participant with a knee arthroplasty was identified as having Sx, ROA, and SOA' | 'Any participant' could mean a replacement in either knee |
| `outcomes.replacement_counts` | `adjudicated_or_self_report` (choices: adjudicated_or_self_report) | oai.derive.knee.REPLACEMENT_STATUS_COUNTS (from Lo 2022 p.1661): V99E*RPCF of 1 (self-reported) or 3 (adjudicated, confirmed), or RPSN = 1 (seen on a follow-up X-ray). Lo 2018 says only 'any participant with a knee arthroplasty' | A counted replacement with no day count (V99E*DAYS blank) never becomes SOA at a follow-up visit |
| `outcomes.roa_rule` | `same_visit` (choices: same_visit, ever) | Lo 2018 Methods: ROA = tibiofemoral KL >= 2; whether ROA is carried forward once seen is not stated |  |
| `outcomes.soa_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, known_false) | Lo 2018 does not say whether SOA is missing or known absent when one component (pain or KL) is missing | known_false: no frequent pain (or KL < 2) rules SOA out even if the other component is missing |
| `periods.after_missing_outcome` | `continue` (choices: continue, stop) | Lo 2018 Results: 750 of 11,994 potential observations missing the outcome were excluded; follow-up after them is not described |  |

## Variants

| Variant | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `arthroplasty_either` | `cohort.arthroplasty_scope = either`; `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope = either` | A replacement in either knee excludes at baseline and counts as SOA at follow-up |
| `corstr_independence` | `model.corstr = independence` | Independence working correlation |
| `exclude_missing_pain` | `cohort.missing_baseline_pain = exclude` | Blank baseline frequent pain excludes the person |
| `left_knee` | `cohort.side = L` | Left knee instead of right (not in the paper) |
| `roa_ever` | `outcomes.roa_rule = ever` | ROA carried forward once a knee has KL >= 2 |
| `soa_known_false` | `outcomes.soa_missing = known_false` | A known absence of pain or ROA makes SOA False even if the other component is missing |
| `stop_after_missing_outcome` | `periods.after_missing_outcome = stop` | A missing outcome ends the person's follow-up |
